pages.text: The $(item)Mob Grinder$() kills mobs in front of it using energy. When placed it faces you; the kill zone is in front of its face. At the largest setting the zone is a 7x7x7 cube; the screen lets you shrink it and show its outline.

Each kill costs 80 OP per point of the mob's health (at least 400 OP). The grinder holds 1 million OP and only runs with at least 4,000 OP stored. Power it with cables or with a charged item in its energy slot.

pages.title: Features
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Weapon slot$(): a weapon placed here is used for the kills, so its enchantments apply. It loses durability but never breaks.$(li)$(l)Items$(): drops are pushed into any inventory touching the grinder.$(li)$(l)Experience$(): orbs are stored, up to 8,192 points. Take 1, 5 or 10 levels, or all of it, from the screen, or pipe it out as liquid XP (20 mB per point).
$(li)$(l)Filter$(): choose what to kill: hostile, tamed, adults, entity type and more. Players are never hit unless the server allows it.$(li)Redstone control is set in the screen.
